name: process_text_effects
purpose: Advance full-screen scrolling and all four timed text-effect slots
exceptional_convention: normally called once per OS VBLANK

name: text_effect_case_timed_clear
purpose: Type 1: deactivate the slot and clear its descriptor chain
exceptional_convention: computed-dispatch entry; inherits parent saved-register frame

name: text_effect_case_blink
purpose: Type 2: alternate the complete descriptor chain between clear and drawn states
exceptional_convention: computed-dispatch entry; inherits parent saved-register frame

name: text_effect_case_progressive_draw
purpose: Type 3: draw the next string character and advance/chains on its terminator
exceptional_convention: computed-dispatch entry; inherits parent saved-register frame

name: text_effect_case_progressive_clear
purpose: Type 4: clear the next string character and advance/chains on its terminator
exceptional_convention: computed-dispatch entry; inherits parent saved-register frame

name: text_effect_case_rotate_forward
purpose: Type 5: rotate each selected descriptor line in the first direction
exceptional_convention: computed-dispatch entry; inherits parent saved-register frame

name: text_effect_case_rotate_reverse
purpose: Type 6: rotate each selected descriptor line in the opposite direction
exceptional_convention: computed-dispatch entry; inherits parent saved-register frame

name: rotate_text_line_forward
purpose: Rotate every descriptor-selected alpha line one cell in the first direction with wrap
exceptional_convention: normal-stack veneer over the A0 register body

name: rotate_text_line_forward_register
purpose: Rotate every descriptor-selected alpha line one cell in the first direction with wrap
exceptional_convention: register entry used by text-effect type 5

name: rotate_text_line_reverse
purpose: Rotate every descriptor-selected alpha line one cell in the opposite direction with wrap
exceptional_convention: normal-stack veneer over the A0 register body

name: rotate_text_line_reverse_register
purpose: Rotate every descriptor-selected alpha line one cell in the opposite direction with wrap
exceptional_convention: register entry used by text-effect type 6

name: scroll_alpha_surface_one_step
purpose: Shift the visible alpha surface one cell and clear the newly exposed edge
exceptional_convention: frameless internal entry

name: display_text
purpose: Draw a chained text descriptor at its current full-screen scroll offset
exceptional_convention: normal API implementation

name: display_text_register
purpose: Draw a chained text descriptor at its current full-screen scroll offset
exceptional_convention: register entry used by the effect engine

name: draw_string
purpose: Draw one NUL-terminated string at an alpha coordinate
arguments: column byte; row byte; string pointer; color/style word
exceptional_convention: normal API implementation

name: draw_string_register
purpose: Draw one NUL-terminated string from a precomputed alpha offset
arguments: D0.w=alpha byte offset; D1.w=color/style; A0=string; A1=word stride
exceptional_convention: register entry

name: draw_text_effect_next_char
purpose: Draw one indexed character for progressive effect type 3
return: D0.l=3 while a character was drawn; 0 at NUL
exceptional_convention: register entry; constructs coordinate slots for 0x304E

name: clear_text_effect_next_char
purpose: Clear one indexed character position for progressive effect type 4
return: D0.l=4 while a character was cleared; 0 at NUL
exceptional_convention: register entry; constructs coordinate slots for 0x304E

name: write_alpha_char
purpose: Write one character/tile plus attributes at an alpha coordinate
arguments: column byte; row byte; character word; color/style word
exceptional_convention: normal API implementation

name: write_alpha_char_register
purpose: Write one precombined character/tile plus attributes at an alpha coordinate
arguments: D0.w=character/tile; D1.w=color/style; coordinate bytes in caller stack at +7/+11
exceptional_convention: shared register/stack body

name: clear_text_descriptor_chain
purpose: Clear all visible non-NUL character cells in a chained text descriptor
exceptional_convention: register entry used by stop/effect paths

name: start_text_line_rotation
purpose: Allocate type 5 or 6 cyclic line rotation according to interval sign
arguments: descriptor pointer; color/style word; signed interval word
exceptional_convention: normal API wrapper into 0x3172

name: init_fullscreen_text_scroll
purpose: Initialize and allocate type 7 full-alpha scrolling
arguments: descriptor pointer; color/style word; interval word
exceptional_convention: normal API wrapper; also stores active flag and interval

name: start_progressive_text_clear
purpose: Allocate type 4 progressive character clearing
exceptional_convention: two-argument API wrapper; forces stored color to zero

name: start_blink_text
purpose: Allocate type 2 whole-descriptor blinking
arguments: descriptor pointer; color/style word; interval word
exceptional_convention: normal API wrapper into 0x3172

name: start_timed_text
purpose: Draw a descriptor and allocate type 1 timed removal
arguments: descriptor pointer; color/style word; interval word
exceptional_convention: normal API wrapper into 0x3172

name: start_progressive_text
purpose: Allocate type 3 progressive character drawing
arguments: descriptor pointer; color/style word; interval word
exceptional_convention: normal API wrapper into 0x3172

name: allocate_text_effect
purpose: Find a free one of four slots and initialize its type, interval, color, counters, and descriptor
arguments: D0.b=type; D1.w=interval; descriptor and color in normal stack slots
exceptional_convention: shared mixed register/stack entry

name: display_large_text
purpose: Render mapped large-font glyphs for a chained descriptor: each character indexes the 128-byte glyph map at 0x34A2, and the resulting index selects the four-byte tile quad at 0x33D2
exceptional_convention: normal API implementation

name: render_large_glyph_register
purpose: Render one mapped large glyph in the orientation selected by A0
arguments: D0.w=glyph index; D1.w=color/style; A0=packed strides; A1=alpha destination
exceptional_convention: register entry

name: init_alpha_display
purpose: Select orientation, reset text effects, and clear the visible alpha surface
exceptional_convention: normal API implementation

name: reset_text_effects
purpose: Reset full-screen scroll state and all four text-effect slot types/descriptors
exceptional_convention: frameless internal entry
